noUpcomingBody: Find a salon near you and book a time.
offlineTap: You're offline. Connect to the internet and tap Show more bookings again.
moreOffline: You're offline or the server can't be reached. Connect and tap Show more bookings again.
moreFailed: Couldn't load more bookings. Tap Show more bookings to try again.
refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh the list. It may be a little out of date.
offerCovers: That time has the salon's offer price.
offerNotCovers: The salon's offer doesn't cover that time.
timeNotFree: That time isn't free any more. Pick another one.
slotTaken: Someone just booked that time. Pick another one.
earlierCantMove: This booking can't be moved any more, so it stays at {time}.
earlierPassed: This time has passed. Your booking stays at {time}.
earlierTaken: Someone else took {time} first. Your booking stays at {current}.
earlierTooSoon: {time} is too soon to book now. Your booking stays at {current}.
earlierFirstWins: Whoever moves first gets it. Your booking stays at {time} if you don't.
showCode: Show this code at the salon when you arrive
arriveBy: Arrive by {time} or the booking may be marked missed.
offerPrice: Booked at the salon's offer price.
earlierAlert: Tell me if an earlier time opens
earlierAlertHint: If someone cancels earlier that day, we'll send you a message. You choose whether to move.
noMoveWithinHour: Bookings can't be moved within 1 hour of the start.
salonNotTakingChanges: The salon isn't taking changes right now, so this booking can't be moved. You can still cancel it.
cancelNowLate: Cancelling now counts as a late cancel.
lateCancelWarning: It's past {time}, so this counts as a late cancel. Too many late cancels or missed bookings can stop you booking for a while.
cancelInfo: The salon will be told, and the time goes back on offer.
cancelledLate: Cancelled. This was counted as a late cancel.
runningLate: Running late? Move it to a later time
missedText: My booking {no} at {salon} on {when} was marked missed, but I was there.
runningLateSoon: Running late? Go as soon as you can: the salon keeps it until {time}.
